listing.name: Wetrix (Wetrix Recompiled)
listing.summary: A Windows port of Wetrix. Set it up with your original US Nintendo 64 game file.

steps.title: Prepare your Windows copy
steps.instruction: Keep your complete permitted Windows x64 copy in a writable folder. Open Wetrix.exe and select your own 8 MiB, big-endian Wetrix USA revision 0 .z64 (SHA-256 790f36a3ddd64e4dcd08c479b0b66f9080d0191473e92fa895f53d15706167bb). The game verifies and imports it to Assets/data.z64.

warnings: Keep the original and Controller Pak save before replacing the program. The project credits bundled HD artwork separately. Use only components you are permitted to use.

references.title: Setup instructions for the inspected release

data_locations: Assets/data.z64, config/user/ and saves/controller1.mpk in the game folder
